state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper's workflow incrementally improves a task decomposition through error diagnosis and amendment: start with a minimal decomposition into LM-performable subtasks (e.g. find the most relevant section, then generate the placebo), then apply it to multiple test inputs that have gold-standard answers. Subsequent steps evaluate results, inspect failing subtasks in ICE and improve them, repeating until performance is good or resources run out.
title: Iterated decomposition loop: decompose, run on gold standards, evaluate, inspect, refine
